mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month, combined with a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases > 10% and UNRATE rises > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases > 10% and UNRATE rises > 0.3% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during an economic expansion regime.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases > 2% over 3 months during an economic expansion.
